title: Honeycomb Sudoku No.507-02
author: kazu3
rules:
Fill every white cell with a digit from 1 to 5.

Each horizontal and vertical run of five white cells must contain the digits 1 to 5 exactly once. Grey cells and the outer boundary separate the runs.

Each five-cell region outlined by thick lines must also contain the digits 1 to 5 exactly once.

Grey cells are not used. The small letters A to E mark the cells used for the solution code; fill these cells with digits as usual.
solutionCode: Enter the digits in the cells marked A, B, C, D and E, in that order, without spaces (5 digits).
